scope: Raw external source files used to reconstruct the frozen G3 seed-44 pilots; source versions and retrieval dates are not inferred from filesystem timestamps.

kaggle.source_url_basis: The public dataset page matches the local filename and Drug 1, Drug 2, Interaction Description schema; the download URL was not separately recorded at retrieval time.
kaggle.relationship_to_drugbank: The Kaggle publisher describes the source as DrugBank-derived; this project therefore treats it as a source-consistency control, not independent external validation.
kaggle.relationship_to_tdc: No TDC download or TDC dataset identity is established by the local provenance record. TDC was not used by the evaluator.

ddinter.partition_note: The eight ATC-organized source partitions overlap; the preparation step canonicalizes symmetric pairs and records duplicate physical rows across partitions.
